case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed residential HVAC & plumbing platform captures $803K annual savings through OEM rebate optimization and indirect spend consolidation
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Cascade Residential Services, a rapidly expanding home-services platform backed by LP First Capital and Trive Capital, managed purchasing through dozens of uncoordinated local agreements across its 13 brands. The decentralized approach obscured spend visibility, delivered inconsistent pricing, and left significant buying power untapped just as the sponsors sought to accelerate margin expansion. To meet aggressive value-creation targets, Cascade needed a fast, enterprise-wide procurement solution that would lock in savings and build sustainable processes.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A rapidly expanding residential HVAC, plumbing and electrical services platform backed by a private equity ownership group managed purchasing through dozens of uncoordinated local agreements across its 13 brands. The decentralized approach obscured spend visibility, delivered inconsistent pricing, and left significant buying power untapped while leadership focused on operational efficiency and margin improvement. To achieve these goals, the platform needed a fast, enterprise-wide procurement solution that would lock in savings and build sustainable processes.
approach_summary: Analyzed 12 months of accounts-payable data across nine spend categories totaling $32.9 million, validating $26.5 million as addressable and prioritizing the top six for action.
Leveraged deep HVAC OEM relationships to negotiate national rebate and pricing agreements with Carrier, Rheem and Lennox, securing rebates up to 16 percent.
Executed quick-hit competitive sourcing events for HVACR & plumbing supplies, issuing MOUs to lock improved distributor pricing while preserving local service levels.
Consolidated the uniform program to a single Unifirst contract via the Rampart GPO, delivering 43 percent cost reduction and simplifying rollout across 13 brands.
Installed procurement governance—standard price lists, rebate tracking dashboards and template agreements—to sustain savings and enable ongoing strategic sourcing.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has already locked in $426K of annual run-rate savings and negotiated an additional $377K pending implementation, for a total impact of $803K—nearly 2x the fixed project fee and on track to surpass the guaranteed 2:1 ROI. Beyond the financial upside, the engagement standardized national pricing, instituted disciplined rebate tracking, and equipped the client with repeatable sourcing templates that will continue to bolster EBITDA and enterprise value.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered the first signed OEM rebate agreement less than 120 days after kickoff, accelerating time-to-value.
Applied specialized HVAC OEM market knowledge to unlock high-tier rebates without requiring minimum volume commitments.
Bridged decentralized data gaps by collaborating directly with suppliers to build SKU-level baselines the client lacked.
Provided ready-to-use MOU and dashboard tools, enabling the client to self-manage pricing compliance post-engagement.
